rotation.extra_rule: Only when verified trend opportunity plus enough render/QA/TTS/publishing capacity. Zero compulsory extras.
rotation.selection: Planner researches daily at 13:00 Moscow and writes the next calendar day's plan. Production at 06:00 reads today's plan and prepares 1–3 Shorts only when justified; 08:00 run verifies/continues. Default one Short. Target publication times 08:00,13:00,18:00 Moscow with ~5h spacing. Maximum two active storylines; finish each; no third until one is closed.
hard_exclusions: Games without a coherent canonical plot
rotation.preferred_story_length: Roughly 3 gameplay hours; owner-approved Tenebris Somnia and ongoing F.E.A.R. exempt. Estimate 2–5 Shorts for most new arcs; extend only if story demands it.
